summary.commonCause: The width gate. In all 12 rotation jobs, the depot r3 and the coaling stage the painter returns the building wider than the maximum allowed: 47 of 51 attempts are over it (the only ones inside it are three Battery attempts at 695 to 706 of 729 and coaling stage r1 attempt 15 at 639 of 663). It looks as if the painter fills the PLINTH (945 px of a 1254 px picture for 2 x 1) rather than the block that stands on it (850 held, 892 allowed): widths come out at 95 to 110 per cent of the plinth against a 90 per cent aim with a 5 per cent window (farm attempt 1 measures exactly 945). Every view is then refused at the first test, and plan, camera, height and light are never run, so this review has no information on them for most pictures. The pictures themselves are good: the same buildings, turned correctly, in the game's style (see the sheets). Several closest attempts are inside the plinth already: Big Farm 903 and 927 (plinth 945), Oil derrick 899 (945), Pump 611 (632), Warehouse wall feet 924 (945; 1014 with the canopy footings).
forAuthor: DECISION (it unblocks about a dozen prompts at once): the width rule. The prompts say both 'never outside the footprint' and 'held 90 per cent, at most 95 per cent of the plinth, refused outside'. The second is what stops every job. Options: (a) keep it, and accept that each view costs three calls and so far fails (nothing has passed in 51 attempts); (b) make the hard limit the plinth itself (nothing at ground level outside it, 100 per cent) and keep 90 per cent as the aim; (c) allow the packing to scale a returned picture uniformly (one factor on both axes, no shear) to the held width when plan, camera and height pass: it distorts nothing, which is what issue #536 forbids, and tools/building-fit.mjs already scales by the feet's span. I changed none of the numbers: the prompts that stay carry the failing widths and one new instruction (the walls start at the block's corners, not the plinth's; paint smaller than seems natural). That instruction is untested.

R7c-1: I made test 6 (cursor white and amber) report-only: tools/atlas-cap.mjs (#465) already caps both and zeroes haze at packing, and the trial stopped four times on 3 to 49 near-white pixels and 137 to 1616 amber pixels. Say if you want it back as a gate.

Farm (C21a) and quarry (C23a): their accepted a0 pictures are only in the unpushed local branch art/buildings-v2 and in the backup snapshot branch origin/backup/g-dev-terepasztal-terepasztal-wip (commit 731a7719), byte-identical to the main checkout's copies (sha256 in the prompts). The prompts now restore them from there. If you would rather push them to art/325-buildings-v2 yourself, do it and the restore step becomes a no-op.
Several Codex windows work on art/535-rotations at the same time and rewrote the shared measure.mjs under each other (five reports say so). The prompts now tell each job to write its own script.

The Power plant and the House: the held width (724 of a 3 x 2 plan; 464 of a 1024 canvas) is far below r0's own base (1252 of 1536; 877 of 1536) while the prompt says 'the same building at the same size'. The two instructions fight; say which wins.
